name: check_book_request
description: Read-only Bookshelf-only status check for one ebook request. The request_id is the positive integer Bookshelf book ID returned by request_book. Reports imported, downloading, queued, grabbed_stalled, searching, requested, or explicit failed state; Bookshelf import is the ebook terminal signal. Never performs mutations; all checks use Bookshelf.

request_id.description: Required positive integer Bookshelf book ID returned by request_book. Do not use a title, author, list position, or opaque string.
